name: Test Candidate
headline: Final-year CSE student | Backend and ML engineer
about: Test Candidate is a final-year Computer Science student who builds backend services and applied ML systems.
Particularly interested in retrieval systems, LLM tooling and distributed backends.

Fine-tuned a DistilBERT classifier for document type routing, reaching 94% F1.

Served inference through a FastAPI backend with a median response time of 310ms.
